# Chou Roam Economy Draft

A greedier Chou route only works if the second setup stays alive after the first threat.

## What to watch

- Check whether earlier damage converts into real pick value.
- Track how often delayed tankiness kills the second engage.
- Reject the route if it only works while snowballing.

## Draft focus

A sharper first threat is worthless if the hero disappears after spending it.

> The route graduates only if Chou still has a second setup.

More on Chou: keep this read connected to fighter roam structures, not just isolated mechanics.
